<a id="a-whole-persists-through-the-generation-of-its-parts--整体经由部分的生成而持续"></a>
# A whole persists through the generation of its parts

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`whole-persists-through-generation` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](whole-persists-through-generation.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where parts are brief, or end with finitely many active at once, a persisting whole needs its parts to keep arising.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. On a web, a formation is the whole of some parts where at every step it is active exactly when some part is; parts cover the steps from T on where some part is active at each; the active parts are listed where at each step a list names exactly them; a formation's activity ends where from some step on it is never active; it is brief for d where it is never active at two steps d apart. (`Becoming.Web.Whole`, `Becoming.Web.Covered`, `Becoming.Web.Listed`, `Becoming.Web.Ends`, `Becoming.Web.Brief`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Being a whole is coincidence of activity, not constitution: on every web every formation is the whole of itself, and in a witness two formations active at every step are each the whole of the other. (`Becoming.Web.whole_self`, `Becoming.Immortal.each_other`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. On any web, a whole arises across a step only as some part arises across it, so a whole that arises at arbitrarily late steps has parts arising at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Web.Whole.arises_part`, `Becoming.Web.Whole.parts_unceasing`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. On any web, where parts cover the steps from T on and no part is active at two steps d apart, no d consecutive steps from any step at or after T pass with no part arising. (`Becoming.Web.Covered.arises_within`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. On any web, where parts cover the steps from T on, every part's activity ends and the active parts are listed: no step is followed only by steps at which no part arises, and, for any finite list of parts, none only by steps at which no part outside the list arises. (`Becoming.Web.Covered.needs_arising`, `Becoming.Web.Covered.needs_new`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
6. On any web, a whole active at every step from T on is covered by its parts from T on; so with parts none of which is active at two steps d apart, no d consecutive steps from T on pass with no part arising, and with parts that each end and are listed, no step is followed only by steps with no part arising, nor, for a finite list of parts, with none outside it arising. (`Becoming.Web.Whole.covered`, `Becoming.Web.Whole.arises_within`, `Becoming.Web.Whole.needs_arising`, `Becoming.Web.Whole.needs_new`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
7. Witness: a whole of one part that is active at every step, its active parts listed, is active at every step while nothing ever arises, the part's activity not ending. (`Becoming.Immortal.immortal`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. Witness: with infinitely many parts, the n-th active up to step n, every part's activity ends, the whole is active at every step and nothing ever arises; so no list names exactly its active parts at each step. (`Becoming.Countless.countless`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
9. Witness: with the n-th member active at steps n and n + 1, the lineage is the whole of its members, which are listed, end and are brief for two steps; the lineage is active at every step and never arises, while a member arises at every step. (`Becoming.Generations.generations`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
10. Witness: with the n-th member active at steps 2n and 2n + 1, the lineage is the whole of its members and active at every step, its members are brief for two steps, and no member arises across a step from an even step: the bound two of the law for brief parts is attained. (`Becoming.Shifts.shifts`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
11. Witness: with the n-th member active only at step n and only if n is odd, the lineage is the whole of its members, which are listed and end; parts arise at arbitrarily late steps, yet the whole is inactive at every even step. (`Becoming.Gaps.gaps`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
12. Witness: a lineage active at every step with two members active at alternate steps is the whole of its members, each brief for one step, so no step passes with no member arising across it; every arising is of one of the two members, and neither member's activity ends. (`Becoming.Layered.composed`, `Becoming.Layered.brief`, `Becoming.Layered.within`, `Becoming.Layered.arise_again`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Whole is a representational premise: which formations are parts of which whole, and whether a lineage is read as the whole of its members, are supplied by the application; the whole relates to its parts only through activity, not through dependence or drawing.
- Brief d (no part active at two steps d apart), or Ends and Listed (every part's activity ends, and at each step a finite list names the active parts): two alternative premises, each taken by its own laws. Listed is a finiteness premise, not one of lasting: in Countless every part ends while the whole persists with nothing arising; Brief does not say that parts end, and admits the same parts arising again (Layered).
- Identity across steps is given by the naming (identity-across-steps): the arising of parts depends on it.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That a whole is constituted by its parts does not follow: being a whole is coincidence of activity. Witness: `Becoming.Immortal.each_other`.
- The whole's dependence, drawing and undermining do not follow from its parts': the whole relates to them only through activity.
- Which formations are parts is fixed for every step: membership changing from step to step is not modelled.
- The laws do not say which part arises, nor that the number of active parts grows.
- The laws are near-definitional: their proofs count through a cover and a finite list, a pigeonhole, and add no dynamics of the parts.
- The witnesses are minimal webs, with no levels, requirements or drawing: they show the premises needed and consistent, not how actual wholes form.
- **Counterexample:** A part that never ends: the whole persists while nothing arises (Immortal.immortal). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Wholes.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Infinitely many parts active at once, each ending at a different step: the whole persists while nothing arises, and the active parts cannot be listed finitely (Countless.countless). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Wholes.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The converse fails: parts arise at arbitrarily late steps while the whole is inactive between them (Gaps.gaps). The bound d is attained (Shifts.shifts). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Wholes.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Whole is coincidence of activity: every formation is the whole of itself (whole_self), and two formations active at every step are each the whole of the other (Immortal.each_other). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Wholes.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Under Brief, generation may be the same parts arising again (Layered.brief, Layered.within, Layered.arise_again): both members of Layered are Brief 1, arises_within applies, no step passes with no member arising, every arising is of one of the two, and neither's activity ends. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Wholes.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

State how a whole's dependence, drawing and undermining are made of its parts' relations, such as a drawing that undermines a member but not the lineage, or the reverse, with membership changing from step to step, and read parts and wholes under dissipation and growth in number (“more”).

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The fifth independent review found that a lineage and its members are two levels of one unfolding, the part–whole relation being what a single level of naming omits, and wrote that a representation with a part–whole relation among formations would make it a theorem, which this result gives. Ren's words (7 October 2026) are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). Where parts are brief, or end with finitely many active at once, persistence read at the level of the whole (the lineage) needs unceasing generation at the level of its members: the two levels are not alternatives, and the whole's 不息 goes through its parts' 生生 (an AI reading and argument; the seventh independent review corrected the earlier “is” and “made of”: Whole is only coincidence of activity). Under Brief this needs only the same members arising again (Layered); under Ends and Listed it needs ever new members (needs_new); neither needs their number to grow, so “unceasingly creating more” in Ren's words does not follow from it; it neither replaces Ren's words nor shows that it is good, and reading 生生不息 at the whole's level is an AI reading.
